title_ru: JANUS POWER v2.0 — семантическая эмуляция как хешируемый нарративный слой

source.declared_module: JANUS POWER v2.0 - INFINITE SEMANTIC EMULATION

valuable_principles: Separate a symbolic representation from the physical system it describes.
Attach provenance and a deterministic content digest to generated state.
Materialize descriptions on demand instead of pretending to store an infinite object.
Represent requests and results as inspectable JSON rather than opaque magical state.

mandatory_capability_corrections.not_admitted: infinite computation, physical world creation, or unbounded storage

mandatory_capability_corrections.admitted_meaning: metaphorical superposition labels in a data structure
creation of a descriptive semantic object
mandatory_capability_corrections.not_admitted: construction or emulation of a real hypercomputer

mandatory_capability_corrections.admitted_meaning: a reproducible content digest for the serialized object
mandatory_capability_corrections.not_admitted: truth, permanence, immutability, authenticity, or external timestamping by hash alone

why_admitted: The source explicitly distinguishes semantic from numerical emulation and offers a useful provenance-oriented symbolic layer once its capability language is bounded.

recommended_route.code_repository: source only after unit tests for hashing, queue lifecycle, failure states, cancellation, and persistence
